subject: Qualification: deployment mode & PoC next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Qualification: deployment mode & PoC next steps

Hi Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary goal: embed high-throughput chat & summarization across two internal products (customer support + knowledge base).
- Traffic profile: spikes up to ~50 qps during peak; average latency target p95 < 200ms.
- Data controls: sensitive PII in subset of requests; legal/procurement will require SOC2 evidence and a VPC option for production.

Initial recommendation
- Start PoC on Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU capacity) for predictable throughput and to validate latency/cost at scale.
- Evaluate a short Hosted API trial for feature validation if you want faster time-to-first-response; plan a separate evaluation for Private (VPC/on-prem) only if procurement requires it.

Proposed PoC/Trial plan (attached: PoC-trial-plan.xlsx)
- Goals & success criteria:
  - Latency: p95 < 200ms for 75-token responses
  - Throughput: sustain 30 qps for 30 minutes during load test
  - Cost: baseline per-token unit economics within target discussed on call
  - Functional: integration with your auth/proxy + sample prompt set
- Duration: 2 weeks engineering setup + 2 weeks trials and validation (4 weeks total preferred)
- Stakeholders: Alex (Product), Samira (Infra/Platform), Marissa (Redwood SE), Ben (AE)
- Next meeting: 30-45 minute kickoff to lock scope, timeline, and confirm technical contacts

Can you confirm:
1) primary technical contact (I think Samira Patel?)
2) any additional success criteria (SLAs, retention limits, logging expectations)
3) target dates for kickoff (we can run next week or the week after)

Thanks — attaching a short PoC plan + a one-pager on deployment options. I cc'd Marissa (SE) to help with technical scoping.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Thanks Ben — good summary. Confirming a few items from our side: 

- Yes, Samira (samira.patel@acme-corp.com) will be our primary infra contact for the PoC. She will take the technical lead on tests and procurement asks.
- We are leaning toward Dedicated for the PoC because predictability is important for our traffic and we want to validate latency under sustained load. Private/VPC is on the table but will likely be a later phase (procurement + security approvals).

Additional success criteria from product/infra:
- Latency: p95 < 200ms (agree)
- End-to-end logging: request IDs in traces for debugging; retention of logs for 30 days is fine for PoC
- Data residency: PoC can run in Redwood's us-west region; for production we need to confirm controls for VPC/on-prem.

Timeline & procurement note:
- Legal/procurement will likely want SOC2 evidence and basic security questionnaire answers before any paid commitment. Can you attach the SOC2/infosec packet?
- Procurement window: we expect a review next month; a 4-week PoC fits our internal timeline.

We can do a kickoff Wed 21 Apr morning PT — Samira and I will be on.

Alex

Hi Alex / Samira — thanks for the clarifications. A few technical notes and a suggested concrete plan below.

Deployment guidance
- Dedicated: best tradeoff for predictable throughput and latency; we can provision a GPU pool sized for your peak and enable autoscaling for burst. Recommended for your PoC.
- Hosted API: fastest to start for feature validation, but exposes variability at scale — useful for initial prompt tuning only.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): recommended when procurement requires network isolation or specific KMS; this adds ~4-6 weeks for onboarding and network setup.

PoC technical plan (2 + 2 weeks)
Week 0-1 (setup)
- Redwood provisions Dedicated pool in us-west; we provide sample integration snippets for your auth proxy and SDK.
- Samira to share a test account and an allowlisted IP range (if you want egress controls).
- Run baseline latency tests with our reference prompts.

Week 2-3 (validation)
- Load test to target 30/50 qps sustained; measure p95, memory/KV cache behavior.
- Functional validation: end-to-end with your product flows + trace IDs.
- Security: provide SOC2 summary + answers to your questionnaire (attaching deployment-options-one-pager.pdf).

Success criteria (concrete metrics)
- Latency: p95 < 200ms on 75-token outputs across 90% of test windows
- Throughput: maintain 30 qps sustained for 30 minutes; no errors > 0.1%
- Integration: SDK/auth integration completed and sample traces available

Open items for kickoff
- Samira: confirm preferred test dates and provide IP ranges/test account
- Legal: Alex to share initial security questionnaire; Ben will surface SOC2 pack and evidence links

Attaching our deployment-options one-pager + the PoC spreadsheet Ben shared. Happy to walk through in kickoff.

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
